claims.statement: For every ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile and represented branch i, A0-Ai=z^3 F_(r_i) H_i, so Delta_p A0-Delta_p Ai=Delta_(p-3)(F_(r_i)H_i). Therefore branch i is strictly selected exactly when this cofactor difference exceeds Delta_p A0.
claims.scope: All m>=1 ordinary path-stars with distinct branches of arity in {2,3,4}, integer zero-extended coefficients, and every natural current rank p; original branch multiplicities do not affect the branchwise polynomial identity. This is a selector identity only, not a universal selection or payment theorem.
claims.reason: Direct expansion proves LB_r-GB_(r-1)=z^3F_r; multiplying by H_i and applying the forward-difference shift gives the stated identity at every zero-extended rank. Strictness is preserved: equality with Delta_p A0 does not select the branch. An independent exact coefficient check verifies r=2,3,4.

claims.statement: A census-free proof that an endpoint-selected eligible row always has at least one represented branch i with Delta_(p-3)(F_(r_i)H_i)>Delta_p A0 would exclude endpoint-only selection on this family.
claims.scope: Actual eligible lower-half ranks only: x is the least natural k with Delta_k P<0 under integer zero extension including the terminal difference; x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha; j=p-2; current-p strict selectors and original tip multiplicities are retained. No proof of the stated universal crossing was obtained.
claims.reason: The conditional implication is exact by the strict selector identity: failure of every crossing is precisely endpoint-only selection when the endpoint is selected. The universal crossing is unproved. Literal endpoint-only exclusion is already available from the accepted computer-assisted aggregate; this remains a census-free proof-method obligation, not new evidence for payment.

limitations: No census-free universal threshold-crossing proof was established.
The exact row is bounded evidence against the stronger nonnegative-cofactor-slope shortcut only; it is not a primary counterexample.
No broad census expansion, Lean build, or source edit was performed.
